title: Heimserver-Retirement terminal abschließen
goal: Verifiziere nach den getrennten Ausführungstasks T060, T061, T063 und T062 den terminalen Heimserver-Retirement-Zustand: kein aktiver Fleet-, Host-, Rollen-, Expositions- oder Ausführungspfad; Heimserver-Repository und Systemkatalog historisch korrekt gebunden; Leitstand-Lifecycle-Consumer produktiv, ohne Retirement als aktuellen Gesundheitsfehler darzustellen.

acceptance.assertion: Task metadata preserves the originating live-register event id and source.
T060, T061, T063 und T062 sind jeweils mit eigenen exklusiven oder lesenden Ressourcen, eingefrorenen Revisionen, Review-Evidenz und Receipts verifiziert, bevor T032 den Closeout ausführt.
Infra PR #131 is merged and the current Grabowski Fleet contains no active Heimserver target.
The merged Heimserver repository contract and Systemkatalog retired lifecycle agree while historical evidence remains explicitly non-authoritative.
The deployed Leitstand consumer displays stable lifecycle separately from technical freshness and runtime health, and a live readback shows Heimserver as retired rather than unhealthy.
Only after all dependency and runtime evidence is current may T032 be changed from blocked to verified in an independent Bureau closeout change.

blockers.detail: The repository-contracts job for the exact Heimserver head failed before creating any steps; merge remains blocked until an actual green run exists.
The dirty ecosystem-lifecycle-freshness-v1 checkout has no current lease, task, process, retention or binding; read-only inspection does not authorize takeover.
